steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Welcome, dear audience, to the eve of your mightily awaited Eighth Dossoles Warrior Champion!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Before we part the curtains, why don't we invite our beloved Mayor Candela up for the opening speech?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Citizens, tourists, with great pride in this city, I welcome you to Dossoles!

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: It doesn't matter where you're from. It doesn't matter who you are.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: You've made it here, so let all that fall away.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Enjoy everything our city has to give you. Enjoy everything you deserve.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Be happy, laugh happy, shout and scream happy.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: This is the paradise I built, and it's all for you!

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Now come! The most unforgettable time of your life is here for the taking!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Okay, big thank-you to Mayor Candela for that speech, just as sempiternally scorched with passion, alright. Moving on, time to introduce your contestants.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Lots of familiar faces this year and last year, but plenty of new ones too!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: First order of business, they look like a lovey-dovey couple, they ARE a lovey-dovey couple, but they're a force on the fighting front!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Honey Summer!

steps.name: Impatient Male Tourist
steps.text: The power of love brought us together.

steps.name: Sluggish Female Tourist
steps.text: The power of love brought us our love.

steps.name: Male & Female Tourist
steps.text: The power of our love is unmatched!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Even I can barely stand before that sparkly power of love! Let's see just how far love's legs can run!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Solo unit up next, the contestant who won the Stomach King Prelims, Mizuki!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Harmless as he looks, he ate through an entire restaurant warehouse. That bottomless stomach and that blue hair are begging to synergize with the ocean here.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Pacer-man!

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Hallo, hallo, hey everyone.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Contestant Mizuki, would you like to say a few words to stir the hearts of the people?

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Hm... I'll eat you all up once I'm tired of playing.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Ooooh! Contestant Mizuki, utterer of terrifying statements in completely normal voices! We look forward to seeing you out there!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Next up, it's a local team, led by Miss Rafaela, who may look cute, but she's got a giant, fiendish sickle. That's the kind of contrast this team's here to feed you.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Let's welcome up—the Grey Feathers!

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Hello to you all.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Miss Rafaela, what do you have to say before the tournament?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Um... I'll do my best.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Ooh, alright, alright, sometimes it's the simple things that touch us deep! Grey Feathers, I think you'll go far!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Right after that, it's a newcomer to this competition, but the team that's drawn the most buzz!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: They're the live scrimmage gatecrashers, winners with an attitude no-one could answer, the supernovas who've picked up Mr. Pancho's support!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: They came from a place the City of Two Suns loves dearly—the Lungmen heroines, Miss Lin Yühsia, Miss Ch'en Hui-chieh, and we even get the local arms dealer, Mr. Ernesto, completing this team—

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: —LUNG wRATh!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Strong, fresh teams spike an appetite like nothing else, and their odds are sitting high! But! Do you truly dare to put your chips down on them?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Alright, let's get your statement. Team leader?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Who's the leader?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ernesto, you do it.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There's no way Lin Yühsia's going to take what I say.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And you wouldn't take what I say either.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Er, alright.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: In that case, we proclaim—we're going to carve our mark into this competition's history!

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: How was that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Mediocre.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Thought so.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Massively assertive! Let's look forward to LUNG wRATh and their vivid display.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Moving on, our next team is...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, Missy, this way.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Coming! Hey, watch my ice cream!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Really, this crowd is insane...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Just goes to show how much attention's on this contest.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Anyway, you see that? Ch'en's carrying some gun-ish thing for some reason.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Guess she's not planning to use her sword this time.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: She's set herself up badly, hasn't she? She was about as good at firearms training as I was.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wow. Excellence doesn't just grow on trees, okay?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Calling her swordsmanship 'excellent' undersells it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, Missy, I gotta say, you're an even bigger Ch'en fan than me, behind her back.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm just stating facts, okay.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah, yeah. More importantly, though, seeing Ch'en without a sword is a sight to treasure. Let's go ask the organizers if we can get a recording of this.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let's not. That would be hell.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's to be so embarrassed about? We'll cut it into a flick. I've already got the title. It'll be 'Gunslinger Old Ch'en Grasps Great Lung Power.'

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And I gotta say, you might have a talent for directing awful B movies.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm flattered. Oh, right, Missy. I've got something to talk to you about.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Not happening.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: C'mon, I haven't even said what it is.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You said 'something to talk about' and I nearly threw up my ice cream. Nothing good comes out of that phrasing.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey. No, just, I saw the officials here had an event on for the spectators.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I looked into it. They let you guess who'll win. And there's a bunch of smaller ones, like who'll be first to get gold, who'll get eliminated earliest, and...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The way you use the word 'guess' absolutely floors me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's government-sponsored. Ship-shape and legal.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ugh. What even goes for illegal in this city?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah... good point, but right now we're just regular tourists, y'know? It's beyond our job descriptions.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And look, even if you want to laugh at Ch'en and Miss Lin, just suppose they do win, we won't be out of pocket, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Makes it a win-win, Missy.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Sigh*... I give in. Here's my card.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mighty thanks, Milady.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't go splashing it about!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I hear you.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Alright, that's all forty teams.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Cameras and drones will capture the whole thing, ensuring you don't miss a single beautiful shot.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: And this main stage isn't gonna stand alone, either. The officials have set up ten more, each one with its own dedicated presenter.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: So you'll get every second, and with commentary just as brilliant to match.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Plus, once the opening ceremony begins, we've got a little wagering opportuntiy for you audience-siders, to make the competition that much spicier.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: All spectators are invited to register your info on the government site, and you can make yourself a little extra cash!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: For specifics on how it'll work, refer to your government-issued competition guides.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Now, then. All the competitors are in our starting district and readied up.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Round 1 will be a search—and a struggle—for pure gold in a partitioned-off area. Teams will then hand it directly to staff at the finish point.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But, they're also allowed to shoot for more! Whatever gold they get belongs to them!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Alright! Mayor Candela, fire off the salute and signal the start of this competition!

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: I declare—Round 1 has officially begun!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What now?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We split up.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And avoid working together. It seems we have yet another common understanding.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: However, before that. We're already being watched.

a.text: Sweeping the surroundings, Ch'en notices a dozen people already surrounding the three of them, closing in with malicious intent.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We break out first.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Good.

a.text: Lin Yühsia faintly nods. Accompanied by only a brush of her hand on the window next to her, the glass gradually vanishes as if melting.
Straight after, a knife blade appears from her palm, almost colorless, only its reflection of the subtle sunshine rays proving its existence.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Oooh, Round 1 of the championship has begun, and the highly anticipated LUNG wRATh has had three other teams cooperate to target them!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Either side is poised to fight!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Will LUNG wRATh once again show their true power, or will the teams united take the win? Let's hold on tight!
